review_evidence: README describes a pure Lean SHA-256 reference implementation intended to be kernel-reducible and accompanied by structural conformance lemmas.
LeanSha256/Core.lean contains FIPS-equivalence statements for SHA-256 round functions, constant/array-size theorems, padding/message-schedule properties, and 32-byte digest-size theorems.
NIST examples and theorems provide checked cryptographic-specification evidence beyond an ordinary hash implementation.
summary: Reviewed LeanSha256; retain the executable SHA-256 specification, FIPS conformance statements, and structural correctness theorems.
